text:
customer_acme: After yesterday's cert rotation, SSO login mostly works but logout fails for ~30% of users. They get redirected back to the app and stay logged in. Stack trace shows assertion/audience validation errors. Can we triage?

emma_support: Thanks — can you paste the raw SAMLResponse (or a redacted snippet) and a failing user's RelayState? Also which IdP (Okta, AAD, custom) is this? :thinking_face:

customer_acme: Okta. Here's redacted snippet (we replaced PII):
```
<saml:Assertion ...>
  <saml:Issuer>https://idp.acme.example</saml:Issuer>
  <saml:Subject>
    <saml:NameID>user@acme.com</saml:NameID>
  </saml:Subject>
  <saml:Conditions>
    <saml:AudienceRestriction>
      <saml:Audience>https://app.acme.example/acs</saml:Audience>
    </saml:AudienceRestriction>
  </saml:Conditions>
</saml:Assertion>
```
When the logout loop happens the validation failure in our logs is: `Audience validation failed: expected https://app.acme.example/acs but got https://app.acme.example/acs%C2%A0`

jake_infra: That looks like a percent-encoded non-breaking space at the end (`%C2%A0`). Could be IdP metadata carrying an ACS URL with a trailing NBSP or Okta UI copy-paste. Did you recently change ACS aliases?

customer_acme: We didn't touch ACS entries in Okta. The rotation was for the signing cert only. Only thing changed was rotating the key and re-uploading metadata via the admin UI.

maria_sre: Upload through UI can introduce weird whitespace. Also different normalization forms (NFC vs NFD) can cause string equality to fail. The `%C2%A0` implies the value includes U+00A0. We see similar in older browsers or if someone copied from a doc with nonbreaking space.

emma_support: Can you fetch the metadata URL and paste the <AssertionConsumerService> values? Example command:
```
curl -s https://idp.acme.example/metadata.xml | xmllint --xpath "//AssertionConsumerService/@Location" -
```

customer_acme: Ran that and see two ACS entries: `https://app.acme.example/acs` and `https://app.acme.example/acs\u00A0` (the second shows as NBSP in raw output). 

eng-saml: This will cause intermittent failures depending on which ACS index Okta sends back in the AuthnRequest/LogoutRequest. Our SP code does strict string comparison of audience/recipient. We should normalize URLs (trim Unicode whitespace, NFC) before comparison. Quick patch idea: apply Unicode normalization + strip all Unicode category Zs around ACS and entityID values at parse time.

jake_infra: For immediate mitigation, add the NBSP-terminated ACS URL as an accepted alias in the SP config for that tenant (we can store both normalized and raw). Customer can also remove the bogus ACS entry from their IdP metadata. Which is faster for them?

customer_acme: We can remove it, but need a change window. Would appreciate quick alias on your side while we schedule cleanup.

emma_support: We can add a temporary alias. @eng-saml can you create a short-lived mapping for tenant acme (expires in 7 days)?

eng-saml: I created an internal issue and pushed a tenant-scoped alias for acme that accepts both `https://app.acme.example/acs` and `https://app.acme.example/acs\u00A0`. Also opened a PR to normalize incoming metadata: https://git.internal/repo/PR/1234. Patch includes:
```
- trim_unicode_whitespace(location)
- normalize_unicode_nfc(entityID)
- percent-decode before compare
```
deploy-bot: prod-deploy triggered by eng-saml/PR-1234 on branch `saml-normalize` — rollout 10% -> 100% over 15m.

maria_sre: Monitoring note: watch SAML 4xx auth failures and logout loop metric (`sso.logout.loop.count`). If it doesn't drop within 30m of the alias, escalate.

customer_acme: Thanks — after alias added we saw logout loop rate drop to ~2% from 30% within 10m. We'll schedule IdP metadata cleanup for tomorrow morning. Appreciate the rapid help. :heart:

emma_support: Great — follow-up actions:
- acme to remove NBSP ACS entry from Okta metadata (customer action)
- eng-saml to merge normalization PR and deploy (permanent fix)
- support to keep alias active for 7 days then remove after confirmation

eng-saml: Will merge after tests (expected within 2 hours). Assigning to oncall for post-deploy watch.

customer_acme: One more oddity — logout from some mobile SSO flows still show the old behavior for a handful of users. Could this be cached metadata on Okta side?

jake_infra: Okta sometimes caches metadata in sessions; ask affected users to fully sign out from Okta and clear app cookies. We'll keep looking if it persists.

deploy-bot: Rollout of `saml-normalize` completed to 100% in prod at +00:18:34.

maria_sre: Post-deploy checks look good: `sso.logout.loop.count` down 95%, `sso.auth.audience-mismatch` down 98%. Closing the emergency path; re-open if mobile caches persist.

customer_acme: All good here. Will report back after IdP cleanup. Thanks everyone! :tada:
